title: EHR, Cohorts, Registries & Synthetic Data
blurb: Large longitudinal research cohorts, national registries, multi-site EHR enclaves and realistic synthetic records for prototyping.

items.name: All of Us Research Hub
items.description: NIH programme building a cohort of 1 million+ diverse US participants with EHRs, surveys, physical measurements, wearables and whole-genome sequences, analysed in a cloud Researcher Workbench.
items.access_note: Public Data Browser is open. Registered/Controlled tiers need institutional data use agreement, identity verification and training; cloud credits are provided free initially.

paper.label: All of Us Investigators. N Engl J Med 2019;381:668

items.name: N3C
items.description: A secure enclave harmonising EHR data from >20 million patients (COVID-19 positive and controls) across US health systems into the OMOP model.
items.provider: NIH National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences
items.access_note: Free; institutional data use agreement + data use request per project. Analysis only inside the enclave.

items.name: Synthea
items.description: Open-source synthetic patient generator plus downloadable synthetic populations (e.g. SyntheticMass) with complete lifetime records in FHIR, C-CDA and CSV — no privacy restrictions.

items.name: CMS DE-SynPUF
items.full_name: Medicare Claims Synthetic Public Use Files
items.description: Synthetic Medicare beneficiary, inpatient, outpatient, carrier and prescription-drug claims (2008–2010) that mirror the structure of real CMS claims for training and software development.

items.name: Diabetes 130-US Hospitals (1999–2008)
items.description: ~100,000 diabetic inpatient encounters from 130 US hospitals with labs, medications and 30-day readmission outcome — a classic teaching and ML benchmark.

paper.label: Strack B et al. Biomed Res Int 2014:781670

items.name: SEER
items.full_name: Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results Program
items.description: Population-based cancer registry data covering ~48% of the US population: incidence, stage, treatment and survival since 1975, analysable with the free SEER*Stat software.
items.access_note: Free; request access online and agree to the SEER Research Data Use Agreement (usually approved within days).

items.name: NCI CDAS (PLCO & NLST)
items.description: Individual-level data, images and biospecimen information from the PLCO cancer screening trial (~155,000 participants) and the National Lung Screening Trial (~54,000 participants).
items.access_note: Free; project proposal and data transfer agreement via CDAS.

paper.label: NLST Research Team. N Engl J Med 2011;365:395

items.name: NHLBI BioLINCC
items.full_name: Biologic Specimen and Data Repository Information Coordinating Center
items.description: Individual-level data from >250 NHLBI-funded cohorts and trials such as Framingham, ARIC, MESA, CARDIA, WHI and SPRINT — a gold mine for cardiovascular and lung epidemiology.
items.provider: US National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute
items.access_note: Free; online request with IRB approval/exemption and a Research Materials Distribution Agreement. Some teaching datasets are open.

items.name: NIDDK Central Repository
items.description: Data and biosamples from NIDDK-funded studies in diabetes, obesity, kidney, liver and digestive diseases (e.g. DPP, TODAY, CRIC).
items.provider: US National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
items.access_note: Free; registration, research plan and data use agreement.

items.name: PPMI
items.description: Longitudinal clinical, imaging (DaTscan, MRI), genetic and biomarker data from thousands of people with and at risk of Parkinson's disease.
items.access_note: Free; online application and Data Use Agreement.

paper.label: Marek K et al. Prog Neurobiol 2011;95:629

items.name: NACC
items.description: Standardised longitudinal clinical and neuropathology data from US Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers (>50,000 participants).
items.access_note: Free; data request with signed Data Use Agreement.

items.name: PRO-ACT
items.full_name: Pooled Resource Open-Access ALS Clinical Trials
items.description: Harmonised records of >11,000 ALS patients pooled from completed clinical trials — the largest ALS clinical trial dataset.
items.access_note: Free registration and acceptance of data use terms.

items.name: UCI Heart Disease (Cleveland)
items.description: Small classic dataset of 303 patients from Cleveland (plus Hungary, Switzerland, Long Beach) with 14 clinical attributes for predicting coronary artery disease — widely used in teaching.

items.name: AI-READI
items.description: Flagship Bridge2AI dataset on type 2 diabetes: 2,280 participants with retinal imaging, ECG, continuous glucose monitoring, wearables, environmental sensors and surveys (~3.9 TB).
items.access_note: Free; controlled-access download via FAIRhub after accepting the licence.

items.name: Undiagnosed Diseases Network (UDN)
items.description: Genomic sequences and deep phenotypes of patients with undiagnosed rare conditions, released annually through dbGaP.

items.name: ISARIC COVID-19 Data Platform
items.description: Standardised clinical data on 700,000+ hospitalised and outpatient COVID-19 patients from 60+ countries.
items.access_note: Free; data access request to the IDDO committee.

items.name: OhioT1DM
items.description: Eight weeks of CGM glucose, insulin, meals, exercise, sleep and wearable data for 12 people with type 1 diabetes.
items.access_note: Free; sign and return a data use agreement.

paper.label: Marling C, Bunescu R. KDH Workshop 2020
